description:
We are a technology-driven team, InfoVerse Cosmos, passionate about AI, space technology, Earth observation and solving real-world challenges.

For this challenge, we aim to combine Dancing with the SARs NASA satellite data, AI/ML, geospatial analytics and GeoSAR Intelligence insights to develop an intelligent decision-support platform for Earthian.

We welcome developers, data scientists, GIS experts,  researchers and creative problem-solvers who want to build impactful technology.
